patches.carries: Xbox Live / system link lobby: 3v3 layout, Edit Arsenal and lists 1-3, Change Rule with Most KOs, First to 5 KOs and Survival (3 revives), Change Game Type, session wins and losses, BFR Options (Teammate Lock-on, Next Map, Tiebreaker Vote); 1.46 the members' face strips follow their outfits
Lab: Enable Battle for Reality skill pack (375+) / Revert back to OG Phantom Dust skills (0-374); 1.48 View Skill Vault (build_lab_vault.py on the 1.47 Lab script); 1.50.77 Effect Lab
arsenal list title with its number; ARSENAL OPTIONS: Add Arsenal, Erase Arsenal, Reset All Arsenals, Acquire All Skills; Arsenal Data: Y picks the stage of the Xbox Live results
Xbox Live arsenal list title with its number; 1.50.10: an arsenal holding a created skill is refused online (the MODS file, same base)
main menu OPTIONS: HUD Preset, the game's own sub-menu with a PREVIEW window (1.45.2, build_hud_option.py v2); 1.50.12 Records, Visions and Stage Music (build_option_more.py)
main menu: EDGAR'S DREAM, MOD LIST (1.43, build_modlist_menu.py) and the BFR MOD PACK line; 1.50.13 EDGAR'S DREAM is CREATE, MULTIPLAYER > Single Play, FEEDBACK and TO-DO LIST
pause menu (offline match / 2P VS): Teammate Lock-on row, A turns it on / off; 1.50.77 Theme row (A = the next visual theme, live); 1.50.80 Day and Night row (A = on / off)

split screen: 3 VS 3 LOBBY, Edit Arsenal and lists, Change Rule with the Create a Mode modes, game type, stage view, arsenal list title, the extra stage rows (Edgar's Dream: Summit); 1.43: monster portraits on X, COMING SOON, the portrait follows the highlighted COLORS outfit; 1.45.6: COLORS 140 wide, the loader moves it into the left black bar
Single Play's first opponent: the practice dummy
Xbox Live COLORS: 1.43 monster portraits on X, the portrait follows the highlighted outfit; 1.45.6 COLORS moved into the left black bar
split-screen select: new player faces, the monster portraits, the outfit cell (1.43); 1.46 the lobby row cells; 1.47 the lobby portraits in colour
Xbox Live select: new player faces, the monster portraits, the outfit cell (1.43; display only, AGENTS.md exception); 1.46 the lobby row cells; 1.47 the lobby portraits in colour
Create Game Session: the BFR rules after Annihilate the Odd One (King of the Hill, Shrinking Arena, Aura Rush, Sudden Death, Realistic Collision ...) (1.47)
mission select: the new character portraits (1.47)

Xbox Live level list: the highlighted stage shown behind the list; 1.50.3 the added stages as rows (build_stage_rows.py on the 1.50 script, the same patch as MODS - AGENTS.md "Pack rows in the Xbox Live LEVEL LIST")
battle HUD: face spots for each fighter's face beside its name - 1.50.15: 6 (fighters 5 and 6 of a 3 vs 3 too; MODS build_hud_faces v3)
Edgar's Dream: Summit - the top of the stairs (ruin pieces out, 8 starts on the summit ring, each with its own 3 capsule spots)
Edgar's Dream: Summit - Edgar's Dream's own model
JD colour 4: JD's own model (the game's colour 4 is Mac) (1.47.6)
Preview Stage - the grid room of stage 32, the four starts on a ring in the middle (to show characters)
